text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Which shaved ice should I get? ♪ Maybe
pineapple since it's
summer? Oh, but kiwi
sounds good too...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... They all look delicious! I need to
take a closer look at the
menu. I'll be right
back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Smart Falcon and I are at the
academy's summer camp,
taking a quick
break between training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Dirt-Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What's the point of going somewhere for summer training camp, when all I see is dirt, dirt, and more dirt! Give me a change of scenery for once!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Out of the blue, I hear a deep sigh. I look
back and see a
familiar-looking runner
kicking at the dirt around her.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm baaack! ☆ I think I'm gonna go with the
Happy Hawaiian Blue
flavor this time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the middle of my observations, Smart
Falcon returns from checking
out the
menu, so we head to the cashier to buy
our shaved ice.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Phew! Another great day of training! Nothing like a frozen treat to get you motivated!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's going on over there? Seems
like there's a huge crowd
gathering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon and I head toward the crowd
to see what's going on.
Once we get
there...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: What do I do? What do I do?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A group of trainers and their Umamusume
trainees surround a lone
trainer. The young
man appears to be panicking, unable to
decide
what to do next.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I wonder what happened here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her guess is as good as mine, so I decide
to ask the trainers there to
shed light on
the situation.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
W-we've got an emergency on our hands!
Break time's over, and my
trainee hasn't
come back yet!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She isn't responding to our attempts to
contact her, even though the
sun's about
to set. If she isn't back before dark, she
may end up lost.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! We've got to hurry up and find her!
C'mon, let's get moving!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Correct. This isn't the time to be
panicking. Let's split into multiple
search
parties. Do you know where she might've
gone?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Thank you all so much! Uhhh, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After determining the trainee's potential
locations, each party goes
their own way
to search. As we head to our assigned
spot...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We're at the far end of the beach. It
doesn't seem like anybody's
here...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe she went out for a walk and
ended up going super far.
Sometimes that
happens.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that we're here, we should get
started on our search! I'll
check the areas
that are farther out! Y'know, since running
on sand is
my thing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eager to look for the lost Umamusume,
Smart Falcon dashes off into
the distance
before I can say anything.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(Is she over here? Or is she that way?
Hrk... I ran so fast I forgot to
pay attention
to where I am...)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(But I agreed to help, so I have to do
whatever I can! Full speed
ahead—max
power! ☆ Let's gooo!)

text_block_list.name: Dirt-Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that... Falco? Why is she running
here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I walk for what feels like an eternity, but
I'm unable to find Smart
Falcon or the
missing Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
How's your search going?! I've looked up
and down the beach, but I
couldn't find
her!

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I see... Dang it! Where do we even look
next?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The clock continues ticking down as our
search hits a wall. We need
to find her
before sundown, no matter what. Just as
we ponder what
to do next...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm baaaaack!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've returned for your heart! ☆ No matter
how far away I go, make
sure to catch
me! ♪ 'Cause I'm the number one
Umadol—Smart
Falcon! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given that her body's completely covered
in sand, I assume that
Smart Falcon has
been running a fair bit. Behind her, I spot
the
missing trainee.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainerrr! I thought I told you to call me
Falco! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh... Sorry for making you worry. I was
too caught up in the
moment, y'know? I
just had to go all out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently the missing trainee had gotten
lost after wandering a bit
too far. It's
thanks to Smart Falcon that she was able
to find her way
back.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aw, I wanted to train some more after
changing, but it's already
dark...

text_block_list.name: Dirt-Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's up? Wait, it's you!

text_block_list.name: Dirt-Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we were on flag duty together,
remember? We both have an
aptitude for
dirt racing... To tell you the truth, I was
never happy
about that... until now.

text_block_list.name: Dirt-Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
When I saw you running earlier, you
looked so happy! It's like you
were
glowing under the sun! It made me think to
myself, "Hey, dirt
racing might not be half
bad!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After sharing her words of gratitude with
Smart Falcon, the thankful
Umamusume
heads off with a dash.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Her eyes... They were sparkling.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And she was looking straight at me...
Ehehe, I think I might have
another fan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone gave everything for their
performances, and it inspired all
the
people watching!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that amazing? It makes me want to
light up the world for other
people too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I guess it doesn't matter how you do things
as long as give it your all!
This calls for a
celebration! To my second fan ever! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Time to show the world my lovely smile! ♪
I'm Smart Falcon, and I'm
the cutest
Umadol around! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once Smart Falcon sets her mind on
something, there's nothing that
can stop
her from racing toward that goal. She's got
charisma and
determination in spades. To
put it simply...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! You're supposed to call me
cute! I'm going to pretend
you never said
that. Now one more time from the top!

Remember—cute, not cool!
